title: feat(app-shell): Setup → Positions creates with permission sets, labels Save, confirms Remove holder, offers members only (objectui#13337)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuFYbrjBZZZg6nE8JKwzSAcA)_

Fixes #13337

Claim: issue comment 6369018114 (Seat: `domain:ui#1`, branch `claude/issue-13337-position-editor`).
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Setup → Positions, the four items the card adopts:

1. **Permission Sets on create.** The position type declared no create fields, so the create form fell back to the required fields plus label, name and description, and `permissionSets` appeared only after the first save. `default-schemas.ts` now registers `createFields: ['label', 'name', 'description', 'permissionSets']` for `position`. The row is the served form's `ref-multi:permission` picker, whose catalog already loads in create mode (the page reads `entry.form` there because the type has no `createSchema`).
2. **Save is labelled.** The generic editor's Save draws the word beside the icon. Its accessible name and tooltip are unchanged (`Save (⌘S)`, or why Save is withheld): the button now carries `aria-label` equal to that title, so every existing pin that finds Save by that name still reads the same button. This is the editor shared by every metadata type, not a position-only change.
3. **Remove holder confirms.** Remove opens an `AlertDialog` that names the person (`Remove Ada Auditor from this position?`); nothing is sent until the confirm, and Cancel writes nothing. The row button keeps its `Remove` name.
4. **Holder picker offers organization members only.** On Add, the section reads the active organization's `sys_member` rows (paged, 500 a page, until a short page) and hands their `user_id`s to `RecordPickerDialog` as `baseFilter: { id: { $in: […] } }`. A refused read is said in the server's words and the picker stays shut; an organization with no member rows says so. With no active organization (the assignment is then stored with none) or no `sys_member` object registered, the picker keeps its whole list.

## Why no server change

The server already refuses the write this picker used to invite: objectstack's `grant-holder-membership-refusal` refuses a non-system `sys_user_position` insert whose `user_id` holds no `sys_member` row in the row's organization (`400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, `reference_not_found`; ruling A carried by objectstack-ai/objectstack#22226), and stands down exactly where this picker keeps its whole list (no organization on the row, no `sys_member` registered). The picker listed a removed user because a platform administrator's `sys_user` read is not narrowed to the organization's peers (`sys_user_org_members` narrows the shipped non-admin sets only). Reading the membership the server judges by is the server's membership, not a client-side filter of a user list. The membership ids travel in the picker's query, so a very large organization makes a long query string; the holder list already reads users by `$in` the same way.

## File surface

As claimed, plus `content/docs/guide/console.md` (the Setup Positions row; AGENTS #2 docs-driven), declared to the seat before the push.

## Tests

- `PositionHoldersSection.confirmAndMembers-13337.test.tsx` (new): confirm names the holder, Cancel writes nothing, confirm deletes; membership read and filter, paging, refused read, empty organization, no active organization, no `sys_member` registered.
- `ResourceEditPage.positionCreate-13337.test.tsx` (new): New Position shows Permission Sets and reads the registry; CONTROL `delegatable` stays out of the create form; Save shows its word and keeps its name and title.
- `PositionHoldersSection.test.tsx`: the remove pin moves (it now confirms first).
- Ablation: with the `createFields` registration removed, the two create-form tests fail.
